name: @9s94ttyfct-bit/omp-webui
description: A modern web UI for the omp coding agent

scripts.lint: biome check . && bun scripts/check-type-scale.ts && bun scripts/check-personal.ts && bun scripts/check-authors.ts
scripts.test:contract: bun scripts/with-model-login.ts sh -c "bun test --parallel --timeout 30000 --timings=.bun-test-timings.json tests/contract && bun test tests/performance"
scripts.test:all: bun scripts/with-model-login.ts sh -c "bun test --parallel --timeout 30000 --timings=.bun-test-timings.json tests/unit tests/contract && bun test tests/performance"
scripts.test:release: bun scripts/with-model-login.ts bun test --parallel --timeout 30000 --timings=.bun-test-timings.json tests/unit tests/contract
scripts.test:live: bun scripts/with-model-login.ts --require-login bun test --parallel --timeout 30000 tests/contract/approval.test.ts tests/contract/guided-goal.test.ts tests/contract/guided-goal-approval.test.ts tests/contract/migrate-resume.test.ts tests/contract/remote-ai-live.test.ts
scripts.test:gui: OMPW_GUI_TESTS=1 bun test --timeout 120000 tests/unit/macos-background.test.ts tests/unit/macos-popout.test.ts tests/unit/macos-quit.test.ts
scripts.test:timings: bun scripts/with-model-login.ts sh -c "bun test --parallel --timeout 30000 --timings=.bun-test-timings.json --update-timings tests/unit tests/contract && bun test tests/performance"
